title: sign.embed
x-produced-by: investor (the signed-in investor app user presses Sign)
x-consumed-by: POST /api/sign/embed — answers in the same HTTP response, never through the outbox
x-rule: M12-S08: the app maps its Supabase user to the Contact (actor.investor_contact_id = ids.investor_contact_id) and signs the body with the contract key. The console checks that Contact is the recipient of that Zoho Sign request, then calls embedtoken. 200 answers { sign_url, expires_at }: a one-time Zoho Sign URL valid for 2 minutes, never stored or logged by either side. A replayed event_id is refused (409): every Sign press mints a new event. 401 bad signature · 400 invalid · 403 not the recipient / host not allowed · 409 replayed or not out for signature · 503 Zoho down.

request_id.description: The Zoho Sign request id the app shows on the paper row.

host.description: The app origin that frames the signing page; must be on the console's allow-list.

app_user_id.description: The Supabase user id (opaque; for the app's own audit, never written to Zoho).
